fact: Per Togo First of 9 Nov 2026, since 2 Nov 2026 interoperable person-to-person transfers in Togo must go through PI-SPI, 17 institutions are authorised to offer it in Togo, and Mixx (first wallet to join, April 2026) can send to banks and other wallets across the UEMOA.
title: Catherine Savery (DG de Mixx Togo) : « Dans cinq ans, Mixx sera une super-app, la référence des services financiers au Togo »
